component.name: WinRDP
component.summary: Windows-native Remote Desktop client for Linux (FreeRDP 3 + OpenGL)

description.p: WinRDP is a native GTK4/Libadwaita and OpenGL 3.3 Remote Desktop (RDP) client built on FreeRDP 3.33.1 with FFmpeg H.264/AVC444 and VA-API hardware decoding support.

Features include a single-window zero-flicker compositor surface, Windows mstsc.exe connection bar, raw scancode keyboard grab, dynamic resolution, bidirectional text/image clipboard, audio/mic redirection, drive sharing, and multi-monitor fullscreen.
